## Kinema 1.5

- **Kultr's look.** Kinema now looks like Kultr: cream pages and warm black text in light mode, warm charcoal in dark (pure black with Night mode), and one orange for whatever you can tap. No gradients: the posters and backdrops are the colour.
  - Buttons on the page are flat, like Apple Music's: **Play** is orange, the round buttons under it and the chips (sorting, filters, seasons) are sand with an orange label. Liquid glass is kept for what floats over the page: the tab bar, the search button, the Downloads title's Pause All.
  - Text follows **Larger Text** in the iPhone's settings.
  - Light and dark now follow the iPhone by default (as in Kultr); if you picked one before, that stays.
- **Four app icons in Kultr's colours.** The Kinema logo now comes in **Cream** (the new main icon), **Ember**, **Night** and **Classic** (the blue of Kinema 1.0). Choose one in Settings → Appearance → App icon.

## Install

Download **Kinema.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac) or **Impactor** (Linux) — or with no computer at all, through **SideStore** installed by **SideInstaller** (only from sideinstaller.net) with **LocalDevVPN** connected. New to this? Follow the step-by-step guide: https://github.com/evropiani/Kinema/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md

Installing over an earlier version keeps your servers, downloads and settings. Kinema needs iOS 17 or later and a Jellyfin server (10.9 or later).
